name: session
description: Session alignment, status, debriefs, next steps, reorientation, handoffs, messaging, transcript workflows, retrospective review, and Session Toolkit CLI guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Align on goals, understand progress, choose next steps, and preserve or inspect sessions.
interface.longDescription: Session skills for aligning on goals, reporting current progress, explaining what happened, recommending next actions, rebuilding long-thread context, transferring work, exchanging addressed messages, inspecting and exporting supported local conversations, and reviewing bounded episodes. Fork to Destination prepares alpha native-fork instructions; seshtk-cli uses the separately installed Session Toolkit CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use Align to confirm goals, Sitrep for current progress, Debrief for what happened, Next Steps for a recommendation, or Reorient for the arc of a long thread. Use the other Session skills to coordinate, preserve, inspect, continue, or review session work.

permission_verification: Static packaging and isolated export execution are verified; live provider discovery and permission behavior remain unverified.
